question: Should OpenClaw add native context-pressure alerting for child/sub-agent sessions, and should the first version be observe-only diagnostics or parent-routed recovery?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested configurable threshold, parent notification, operator alert, and recovery action would create new product/API semantics rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define narrow diagnostics first
options.body: Add a saturated-session/context-pressure classification covering active and terminal child sessions, then expose it through status/diagnostics before adding automatic recovery.

options.title: Add configurable recovery routing
options.body: Introduce threshold, parent target, and recovery action config now, accepting a larger compatibility and product surface.

options.title: Keep monitoring external
options.body: Decline native alerting and document existing status, diagnostics, and custom monitoring paths instead.

recommendation.title: Define narrow diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Add a saturated-session/context-pressure classification covering active and terminal child sessions, then expose it through status/diagnostics before adding automatic recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on subagent completion delivery and subagent monitoring makes this the strongest adjacent product/code routing candidate.
